notes: Reviewed unchanged: the accepted alignment partitions all 7 source and all 11 target ids exactly once, every head is a member of its own array, and no unit needed correction.

Both English determiners are supplied for anarthrous Greek nouns, so rule 51's anarthrous clause makes them helpers on 'wrath' and 'righteousness' rather than evidence of an article; no source article exists anywhere in this verse, so rules 19-23, 51, 57 and 60 are all out of question.

The competing reading for s003 and s005 would split 'of' onto a determiner-bearing article; none is present, and rule 21 forbids leaving a bare 'of' on anything but an article that takes the English determiner, so 'of man' and 'of God' each stay one unit headed on the noun.

Rule 58 was checked and does not apply: it governs a supplied determiner over an anarthrous adjective-plus-noun phrase, and the modifiers here are genitive nouns, each of which carries its own English word already.

Variant SBLGNT.JAS.1.20.v005 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base, covering s006 and s007; no textual decision is taken here (rule 12), and the unit carries no FALLBACK EXCLUDED mark, so rule 97 does not apply.
